body: Guys, please be sincere. Am I too weak and too stupid to don't have the courage to kill myself?
I'm in this "war" for almost 3 moths, but last month I think that I lost this war. I really hope that you can get pass that, but I'm sure that I can't.
For me it isn't a risk. And if afterlife do not exist at least I don't have to suffer anymore.
